hooks.text: Four astronauts flew 252,756 miles from Earth to break a historic record.
Which mission carried humans farther from Earth than any flight in history?
Humanity broke Apollo 13's deep space record by traveling 252,756 miles.

title: The Deep Space Flight That Broke Apollo 13's Record
description: NASA's Artemis II mission carried four astronauts 252,756 miles into space, shattering Apollo 13's historic record.

beats.text: Four astronauts flew 252,756 miles from Earth to break a historic record.
beats.visual: Illustration of the Orion spacecraft in deep space near the Moon, 2026
queries: Artemis II Orion deep space illustration

beats.text: Launching in April 2026 aboard NASA's Space Launch System, Artemis II surpassed Apollo 13's deep-space distance.
beats.visual: Space Launch System rocket launching from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, 2026

beats.text: Flying inside the Orion capsule Integrity, the crew traveled on a lunar free-return trajectory without landing.
beats.visual: Artist rendering of Orion spacecraft Integrity flying on a lunar free-return trajectory, 2026

beats.text: ESA's European Service Module propelled the ten-day test flight to validate critical spacecraft systems.
beats.visual: European Service Module attached to Orion spacecraft in deep space, 2026

beats.text: Commander Reid Wiseman and pilot Victor Glover even completed manual proximity maneuvers using their rocket's upper stage.
beats.visual: Official portrait of Artemis II astronauts Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover, 2023
queries: Reid Wiseman Victor Glover Artemis II portrait

beats.text: Mission specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen flew as the first woman and non-American beyond low Earth orbit since 1972.
beats.visual: Official portrait of Artemis II mission specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen, 2023
queries: Christina Koch Jeremy Hansen Artemis II

beats.text: After a Pacific Ocean splashdown off San Diego, their flight proved how far people can venture into the cosmic unknown.
beats.visual: Orion capsule floating in Pacific Ocean during recovery operations off San Diego, 2026
queries: Artemis II splashdown San Diego Navy
